text:
Zoe - Design: quick a11y review of the Metrics table column reordering (drag handle) — keyboard users can't reorder, and SRs don't get position updates.
Arun (Eng): current impl uses HTML5 drag/drop with a grab handle icon that's not keyboard-focusable. We should provide an alternative keyboard flow.
Mei - QA: axe doesn't flag this. screen readers need live feedback like 'Column X moved to position 2'.
Ben - Product: expected behaviour: both mouse drag and keyboard move (move-left/move-right) + clear visual drop indicator.
Zoe - Design: proposals:
- make handle a focusable button with aria-label="Drag to reorder {columnName}"
- implement keyboard reordering: when handle focused, use Space to pickup, ArrowLeft/ArrowRight to move, Space to drop. update aria-grabbed or use aria-live.
Arun (Eng): prefer using a roving focus + 'picked' state and an offscreen announcer. example announcer update: `announcer.textContent = `${colName} moved to position ${index + 1}`;`
Mei - QA: also ensure visible indicators: strong focus ring on the grabbed item and a 3px dashed insertion line with >=3:1 contrast. Test matrix: VoiceOver, NVDA, Chrome+Edge, keyboard only.
AccessibilityBot: automated scan notes: 1 major (non-focusable handle), 2 minors (no live announce, low-contrast insertion cue).
Arun (Eng): code sketch for keyboard pickup/drop:
```js
handle.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
  if (e.key === ' ') { e.preventDefault(); togglePicked(handle); }
  if (picked && (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowRight')) { moveColumn(pickedIndex, delta); announcer.textContent = `${name} moved to position ${newIndex+1}`; }
});
```
Zoe - Design: aria notes: use `aria-grabbed="true/false"` on the handle for legacy SRs, and `aria-live="polite" aria-atomic=true` for announcer updates. Make sure `role="list"` + `role="listitem"` for table columns if we go non-native.
Mei - QA: i'll add an E2E keyboard test that simulates Space + Arrow and asserts announcer text changed.
Arun (Eng): timeline: patch this week if we keep changes to attributes + small JS. I'll prototype keyboard flow and visuals.
Ben - Product: good catch, priority P2. ping me when demo ready.
Zoe - Design: follow-ups: Arun prototype (D:1), Mei tests (D:2), final SR pass after PR. :white_check_mark:
